correctness.rationale: For finite simple K5-minor-free G with ≥1 edge, the unique full-dimensional John ellipsoid is invariant under cut-switching coordinate reflections; individual edge flips force center=1/2, and singleton endpoint flips separating any pair of distinct simple edges force covariance diagonal. Barahona–Mahjoub Cor3.10 gives all nontriangle coordinate and odd chordless-cycle facets. Ellipsoid support on a k-cycle yields Σ_{C}s_e≤(k−2)^2/4; triangle k=3 is active, while coordinate cap s_e≤1/4 implies all k≥4 cycle inequalities, with possible k=4 equality only if all four s=1/4. Strict concavity of Σlog s and positive Slater point imply unique optimum with box and triangle constraints. Contact equality and Q a/√(a^TQa) yield exhaustive facet contacts; wheel and book formulae satisfy exact KKT. Independently checked their rational multiplier identities for wheels 4≤k≤24 and books 1≤n≤29. Finite computations do not replace all-graph cut facet theorem.
residual_risks: K5-minor-free is essential: extra facets can invalidate triangle locality beyond this class.
Triangle books with n=1 are K3 and the family formulas coincide; no extension to the global Löwner ellipsoid or nonminorfree cut polytopes.
